description: A Kotlin class 'MatchDetailFragment' extending Android's Fragment, responsible for displaying match details, including scores, team names, match status, and optionally playing highlight videos via ExoPlayer.

classes.name: MatchDetailFragment
classes.description: A Fragment that displays match details and plays highlight videos if available.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Initializes views, retrieves match ID, observes match data, and updates UI including video playback.

methods.name: ensurePlayer
methods.description: Initializes the ExoPlayer instance if it hasn't been created.

methods.name: onStop
methods.description: Pauses video playback when the fragment stops.

methods.name: onDestroyView
methods.description: Releases ExoPlayer resources and clears the PlayerView when the view is destroyed.
